shortBio.en: GnR rhythm guitar/songwriter on Appetite; exits 1991 before Illusion peak strain.
shortBio.zh: Appetite 时期 GnR 节奏吉他/写手；1991 在 Illusion 峰值张力前离队。

body.en:
Born 1962. Rhythm and co-writing on Appetite-era songs; Stones-derived chord economy beside Slash leads. Leaves 1991 as the band scales to Illusion epics.

Citation value is Appetite five chemistry more than later solo catalog.
body.zh:
1962 年生。Appetite 时期节奏与共写；在 Slash 主音旁提供 Stones 系和弦经济。1991 乐队扩向 Illusion 史诗时离队。

引用价值在 Appetite 五人化学，多于后期独唱目录。
